items.headline: Nelly Korda Hall of Fame
items.text: Nelly Korda needs just one major win, like the KPMG Women's PGA Championship, to reach 27 points and qualify for the LPGA Hall of Fame.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark US Open Success
items.text: Wyndham Clark leads his second US Open trophy at Shinnecock Hills in the last four attempts, showcasing a model performance Rory McIlroy could learn from.
